paper_title: First indirect detection constraints on axions in the Solar basin
notes: Limit on axion-photon coupling g_agamma with g_aee=0, from Fig. 2 (lim_photon_all.pdf) of the e-print, traced by vector extraction (pymupdf get_drawings) with axis calibration from tick labels. The paper shows three method curves (Poisson, Yellin/optimum-cuboid, CLs). I traced the CLs curve, the most stringent of the three (paper: 'most stringent in most of the parameter space'); it defines the lower boundary of the total excluded region (g > curve). The Yellin (background-agnostic 'robust') and Poisson curves lie within ~1.5-2x above it. Bathtub-shaped exclusion over m~7-29 keV; CLs weakens/starts at higher mass at low m due to the 4 keV energy cutoff. The paper's other main figure (Fig. 1) is the DFSZ 'universal coupling' case (g_agamma=alpha/2pi f, g_aee=m_e/f) plotted vs decay constant f; that case yields a corresponding AxionElectron limit not reported here. Density is not an assumed DM halo value (the solar-basin density is computed from the injection/decay balance), so dm_density_assumed=null. 90% CL per figure title.
